senses.definition: A thin strip or small torn piece of something.

senses.definition: To make a sudden, loud, high cry.

senses.definition: To become smaller or to make something smaller.

senses.definition: To pass material through a screen so the small pieces fall through and larger ones stay behind.

senses.definition: To look carefully through many things to find what you need.

senses.definition: Spoons, forks, and knives used for eating or serving, regardless of whether they are made from silver.

senses.definition: A comparison that uses a word like “as” or “like” to connect different things.

senses.definition: Honest in what you say or feel.

senses.definition: To make music with your voice by moving among notes.

senses.definition: To make a quick drawing or briefly describe the main parts of a plan or idea.

senses.definition: An ability you can use and improve with learning and practice.

senses.definition: The group of bones that shapes the head and surrounds the brain.

senses.definition: To lean or slope at an angle.

senses.definition: To be in the natural resting state in which you are less aware of things around you and may dream.

senses.definition: A flat piece cut from a larger thing, usually fairly thin.

senses.example: We waited for the seeds to sprout.

senses.definition: A flat shape with four equal sides and four right angles.
senses.example: We divided the square into four smaller squares.

senses.definition: An open public space in a town or city, often surrounded by buildings.
senses.example: The farmer set up a stall in the town square.

senses.definition: To multiply a number by itself.
senses.example: To square five, multiply five by five.

senses.definition: A number you get by multiplying a whole number by itself.
senses.example: Thirty-six is a square number because six times six is 36.

senses.definition: The number zero or greater named by the square root symbol. Multiplying it by itself gives the number under the symbol.
senses.example: The square root of 49 is seven.
